alt.en: An arXiv paper describes how malicious tool outputs can impersonate users and proposes role detection with linear probes. The saved abstract provides no deployment fix or quantitative results.
alt.zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文描述了恶意工具输出如何冒充用户，并提出用线性探针检测角色。保存的摘要未提供部署修复方案或量化结果。
